subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Billie Eilish's When We All Fall Asleep
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Billie Eilish's When We All Fall Asleep.

hook.text: Seventeen-year-old Billie Eilish recorded her debut album in her brother's tiny bedroom studio.

buildup.text: Finneas produced whispery vocals, deep bass, and unsettling sounds using affordable equipment.

discovery.text: The intimate production style made listeners feel like Billie was whispering directly into their ears.

twist.text: The bedroom album swept five major Grammys, beating records from the world's most expensive studios.

climax.text: The album proved that intimacy and creativity matter more than studio budgets in modern production.

punchline.text: A teenager's whisper defeated million-dollar studios.

quiz.question: How old was Billie Eilish when she recorded her debut album?
